notes: Study-day sort fix + per-box add-to-calendar (1.11.11): ONE shared comparator compareBoxOrder() (study day first, then studyDayMinutes() position inside the study day: 03:30 -> 0, 23:00 -> 1170, 00:30 -> 1260, 03:29 -> 1439) replaces every raw-clock box sort in app.js (dashboard, calendar day list, backlog x2, assignments) and analytics.js (archive, heatmap day detail, review-past, CSV export) — a box starting after midnight now sorts at the END of its study day instead of first; grouping (boxStudyDay) and the 03:30 boundary unchanged. Per-box «افزودن به تقویم» button under the corner status box on disconnected boxes only (shared helper calAddToCalBtnHtml at all 7 corner-box sites: partCard = dashboard + calendar day, backlog, assignments, archive, review-past x2); POST /api/boxes/push-one creates ONE Google event for that box (programme or custom, idempotent — already-linked creates nothing), records event_map/created_ids/ical_map/uid_map + last_pushed, clears the orphaned flag, so the corner flips to «در تقویم ✓»; OAuth-not-connected returns the same Persian error as the bulk push. Custom boxes now get their uid stamped in allBoxes() too (was hardcoded null, so a pushed custom box could never show connected).
